finding: Starting February 1, 2027, Shorts ads targeted to specific channels in groups of five or fewer channels are eligible for direct revenue; monetizing creators keep 45% of net revenue from the specific ad, in addition to Creator Pool revenue.
old_approach: Treat Shorts ad monetization only as Creator Pool allocation based on eligible engaged views.
new_rule_or_hypothesis: Keep engaged-view/retention optimization as the current core. From 2027-02-01, if the channel is monetizing and targeted Shorts ads are actually observable, track direct targeted-ad revenue separately from Creator Pool revenue; do not optimize for it before eligibility/availability is verified.
test_metric: After 2027-02-01: verify monetization eligibility and any channel-targeted Shorts ad revenue signal; compare direct targeted-ad revenue separately from Creator Pool revenue without conflating it with views/retention.
failure_fallback: If targeted-ad reporting or eligibility is unavailable, mark TARGETED_SHORTS_ADS_UNVERIFIED and continue existing engaged-view/retention/Creator-Pool metrics; no inferred revenue.
provenance: Official YouTube Help page retrieved on 2026-10-06.
